SELECT #{deptId} AS deptId, COUNT(DISTINCT am.employee_id) AS totalEmployees, SUM(am.work_days) AS totalWorkDays, SUM(am.actual_days) AS totalActualDays, AVG(am.attendance_rate) AS averageAttendanceRate, SUM(am.late_times) AS totalLateTimes, SUM(am.early_times) AS totalEarlyTimes, SUM(am.absent_days) AS totalAbsentDays, SUM(am.missing_times) AS totalMissingTimes FROM hr_attendance_monthly am INNER JOIN hr_employee e ON am.employee_id = e.id WHERE am.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND am.year = #{year} AND am.month = #{month} AND am.deleted = 0 AND e.deleted = 0
AND e.dept_id = #{deptId}
